title: Their land a pawnshop.
html_source: History passed on from one generation to the next, unwanted, but repeated as destiny from which one cannot seemingly escape.

anchor.prefix: isesteemed, winning a clement master's praise. Why had they chosen all that part? Not wholly for the smooth caress. For them too history was a tale like any other too often heard,
anchor.suffix: Had Pyrrhus not fallen by a beldam's hand in Argos or Julius Caesar not been knifed to death. They are not to be thought away. Time has branded them and fettered they are lodge
